propositions: Five analysis and calibration artifacts cited in merged tickets (cranial-goodly-seahog, restoring-shallow-blobfish) and in production code (criteria_routing.json) do not exist on origin/main, leaving dangling citations and broken provenance trails

The calibration and oracle artifacts are the empirical basis for design decisions (code-v3 threshold blocking set, surface-parity oracle) but exist only as untracked working-tree state in one checkout
docs/experiments/calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py is cited in three _comment fields of criteria_routing.json and cannot be inspected from the repo

Five artifacts (calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py, code-review-threshold-calibration.md, escaped_bug_analysis.py, escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md, write_parity_oracle_prototype.py) must be committed verbatim to docs/experiments/ to resolve dangling references
Landing the artifacts restores the complete audit trail for the code-review calibration decisions and the write-parity oracle design without affecting runtime or lint scope
